rows.jyutping: zung1 tou4 teoi3 hok6 ge3 jan4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering for someone who leaves school without finishing.

example.english: My former colleague was a dropout and is now very successful in business.
example.traditional: 我以前個同事係中途退學嘅人，而家做生意好成功。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 go3 tung4 si6 hai6 zung1 tou4 teoi3 hok6 ge3 jan4 ji4 gaa1 zou6 saang1 ji3 hou2 sing4 gung1

rows.meaning: person who opts out of society
rows.jyutping: tyut3 lei4 zyu2 lau4 se5 wui6 ge3 jan4
rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who deliberately opts out of mainstream society, not for an educational dropout.

example.english: They chose to live in the mountains as a dropout from mainstream society and no longer use a mobile phone.
example.traditional: 佢索性搬入山住，做個脫離主流社會嘅人，連手機都唔用。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sok3 sing3 bun1 jap6 saan1 zyu6 zou6 go3 tyut3 lei4 zyu2 lau4 se5 wui6 ge3 jan4 lin4 sau2 gei1 dou1 m4 jung6
